description: Requirements traceability for the structured PR preflight evidence runner. Each MUST requirement is bound to live-engine tests and code on main; verification_method names how it is proven and failure_status names the fail-closed outcome.

requirements.statement: A structured JSON report is emitted on every execution, including failing and blocked runs.
acceptance_criteria: preflight_report.json exists after a failing run
report contains schema_version, status, checks, summary, first_file_to_open

requirements.statement: Per-check stdout and stderr are preserved to on-disk log paths.
acceptance_criteria: each check declares stdout_log and stderr_log paths
captured stdout/stderr are written to those paths

requirements.statement: A critical check failure produces a nonzero exit; exit code is a pure function of final status.
acceptance_criteria: status PASS -> exit 0
status FAIL -> exit 1
status BLOCKED -> exit 1

requirements.statement: A missing critical executable blocks (BLOCKED), never silently passes.
acceptance_criteria: missing critical tool -> status BLOCKED
tool_available is false
exit code 1

requirements.statement: A missing optional executable skips explicitly (SKIPPED_OPTIONAL) and is never critical.
acceptance_criteria: missing optional tool -> SKIPPED_OPTIONAL
a SKIPPED_OPTIONAL check is never critical

requirements.statement: The shell wrapper holds no critical check logic; it only delegates to the Python runner.
acceptance_criteria: wrapper invokes tools/ci/pr_preflight.py
wrapper contains no inline ruff/black/mypy/pytest/detect-secrets logic

requirements.statement: The shell wrapper forwards the runner exit code and only advertises the report when it exists.
acceptance_criteria: wrapper exit code equals runner exit code
FIRST_FILE_TO_OPEN printed only when preflight_report.json exists

requirements.statement: The report JSON schema matches generated reports and stays in lockstep with the engine status constants.
acceptance_criteria: an engine-built report validates against schemas/pr_preflight_report.schema.json
schema status enums equal ALLOWED_FINAL_STATUSES and ALLOWED_CHECK_STATUSES

requirements.statement: Fail-closed behavior is proven across the failure surface: report-write failure and invalid root both block with a nonzero exit and never emit a PASS.
acceptance_criteria: report-write failure -> stderr reason -> exit 1 -> no PASS
invalid root -> BLOCKED report with invalid_root check -> exit 1

requirements.statement: An unspecified/unknown check status collapses to BLOCKED; no unknown status can appear in a valid report.
acceptance_criteria: _base_result default status is BLOCKED
a report with an unknown status is rejected by the schema and contract
